title: Texas sunsets are unfair.
old_caption:
Taking selfies with your back to the best sunset in Texas?
The stars say put the phone down and watch the sky with someone.

title: Leo plans a surprise.
old_caption:
Planning a big surprise for someone who hates the spotlight?
Leo learns to read the room. Surprise them their way.

title: Road trip: the swimming hole
old_caption:
Nervous about trying something new together?
Gemini and Sag jump into a freezing swimming hole. The cold passes, the memory stays.

title: Dear Libra: Thai or sushi, part two.
old_caption:
Libra, still stuck at the crossroads between two restaurants?
Then a taco truck rolls up and the scale finally balances. Picked.

title: First-date small talk in Houston.
old_caption:
First date and all you can talk about is the weather?
Skip the small talk. Ask what hill they would happily argue on.

title: Virgo is counting the votes.
old_caption:
Virgo is counting the city votes, every single one twice.
There's no winner yet and more are coming. Which city do you want next?

title: Taurus and Scorpio, finally.
old_caption:
Two stubborn signs, one armchair. Who wins?
Taurus and Scorpio laugh, share the seat and split the last kolache.

title: tonight's deck
old_caption:
From Amarillo to Corpus Christi, who is getting dealt in tonight?
Same deal, bigger table: a fresh hand every night across Texas.

title: Dear Sagittarius: you're staying?
old_caption:
Always one foot out the door, backpack packed?
Sagittarius unpacks and finds adventure close to home. Stay curious, together.

title: Venus moved to Houston, too.
old_caption:
Do you know your Venus sign?
Venus rules Taurus and Libra, but everyone has one, and it shows how you love. Start with one good question.
